podcast.title: Death at Hard Rock Cafe Hotel (June 27, 2002)
podcast.body: John Entwistle, the bass player for The Who, died in room 658 of the Hard Rock Cafe Hotel in Las Vegas on June 27, 2002. The coroner attributed his death to an undiagnosed heart condition, with cocaine also being a contributing factor. "John Edwistle, bass player for the Who, died in room 658 of the Hard Rock Cafe Hotel in Las Vegas on June 27, 2002."
